raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`SGLANG_HIP_DSV41_INDEX_K_PAGE8` stores the ratio-1 index-K pool in AITER's row-group page-8 order. The page size and shapes match page-64; only the bytes differ, so PD peers must agree (the pool's own comment says so). Nothing enforces this today:

- `pd_kv_layout()` covers only the main and compressed KV layouts.
- The transfer compares item lengths, which are the same in both layouts.

A page-8 prefill paired with a page-64 decode, or the reverse, therefore passes the handshake. The decode reads the transferred index keys in the wrong order, its top-k picks the wrong blocks, and no error is raised. The same pair is also formed when both peers set the env but one peer's AITER lacks the row-group kernel and falls back to page-64. Monokernels are not involved; any DeepSeek-V4.1 PD pair can hit this.

## Modifications

- `DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool.pd_kv_layout()` appends `idx{ratio}:page8` for each index-K pool in the page-8 layout, after the fallback is resolved. The existing `KV layout mismatch` check in `CommonKVManager` then refuses such a pair. With page-8 off the name is unchanged, so a default-config pair still pairs whether or not each peer has this change.
- The mismatch error now names `SGLANG_HIP_DSV41_INDEX_K_PAGE8` beside `SGLANG_DSV4_KV_LAYOUT`.
- A unit test in `test_dsv4_compressed_pools.py` checks the page-8 name.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSpark, 1P1D on one MI355X node over MoRI, TP4 each, no monokernels, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261028` running this branch. Its AITER has the row-group kernel, so page-8 is in effect where set. GSM8K is `sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k` with 1319 questions, sent through the PD router.

| SGLang | prefill PAGE8 | decode PAGE8 | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| this PR | 1 | 0 | refused at the first transfer: `KV layout mismatch: prefill server has kv_layout=v4,c1:v4,c2:v4,idx1:page8, but decode server has kv_layout=v4,c1:v4,c2:v4. ...` |
| this PR | 1 | 1 | serves; GSM8K 0.911 at parallel 64, 0.894 at parallel 8 |

On main, the mismatched pair loses 7 to 9 points against matched pairs (0.889 to 0.911 at parallel 64 on this setup) and raises no error. This PR refuses the same pair at its first transfer.

`test_dsv4_compressed_pools.py` on GPU: the new test passes. Five `TestDSparkDraftRingWithEncoderReplay` cases fail on both main and this branch in this image, so they are not from this change.
| main | 1 | 0 | serves with no error; GSM8K 0.823 at parallel 64, 0.835 at parallel 8 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: the change only extends a handshake string.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -1353,7 +1353,8 @@ def try_ensure_parallel_info(self, bootstrap_addr: str) -> bool:
             raise RuntimeError(
                 f"KV layout mismatch: prefill server has kv_layout={info.kv_layout}, "
                 f"but decode server has kv_layout={self.kv_layout}. Both servers "
-                f"must use the same --dsv4-attn-backend and SGLANG_DSV4_KV_LAYOUT."
+                f"must use the same --dsv4-attn-backend, SGLANG_DSV4_KV_LAYOUT and "
+                f"SGLANG_HIP_DSV41_INDEX_K_PAGE8 (with an AITER that has its kernel)."
             )
 
         local_layout = self.dsv41_spec_layout

@@ -1689,14 +1689,21 @@ def compressed_kv_layout(self, compress_ratio: int) -> KVLayout:
         return layout
 
     def pd_kv_layout(self) -> str:
-        """The main and compressed KV layouts, which PD peers must share."""
+        """The byte layouts PD peers must share: the main and compressed KV, and which
+        index-K pools use the page-8 layout (same size as page-64, so only this name
+        tells the two apart)."""
         if self.uniform_fp8:
-            return KVLayout.UNIFORM_FP8.value
-        compressed = [
-            f"c{ratio}:{self.compressed_kv_layout(ratio).value}"
-            for ratio in sorted(set(self.compression_ratios) - {0})
+            names = [KVLayout.UNIFORM_FP8.value]
+        else:
+            names = [self.kv_layout.value] + [
+                f"c{ratio}:{self.compressed_kv_layout(ratio).value}"
+                for ratio in sorted(set(self.compression_ratios) - {0})
+            ]
+        names += [
+            f"idx{ratio}:page8"
+            for ratio in sorted(self.low_ratio_index_k_page8_ratios())
         ]
-        return ",".join([self.kv_layout.value, *compressed])
+        return ",".join(names)
 
     def _make_indexer_pool(
         self,

@@ -384,6 +384,16 @@ def test_pd_layout_names_the_arrangement(self):
         self.assertNotEqual(names[KVLayout.V41], names[KVLayout.V41_NEW])
         self.assertIn("v41_fp4_new", names[KVLayout.V41_NEW])
 
+    def test_pd_layout_names_the_page8_index_k_pools(self):
+        """The page-8 index-K pools have the same size as page-64 ones, so the PD
+        handshake must refuse a pair that differs only there."""
+        page64 = self.make_pool([0, 0, 2, 1, 1], [2, 3], KVLayout.V41)
+        page8 = self.make_pool([0, 0, 2, 1, 1], [2, 3], KVLayout.V41)
+        page8.index_pools[1].index_k_page8 = True
+        self.assertEqual(page8.low_ratio_index_k_page8_ratios(), frozenset({1}))
+        self.assertNotIn("page8", page64.pd_kv_layout())
+        self.assertEqual(page8.pd_kv_layout(), page64.pd_kv_layout() + ",idx1:page8")
+
     def test_pd_entries_cover_the_c4_kv_page_count(self):
         """The PD transfer walks every registered entry with the c4 KV pool's
         page count, so the c4 indexer must reserve the same FULL logical page."""
